levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The system has no real structure before day one, or day one's tasks are not real, current tasks.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A real structure is built before day one, populated with genuine current tasks.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The structure is built with a clear reason for the chosen format, matched to how the learner actually tends to work.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Daily log entries are generic ('it went fine,' 'it didn't work') across all three days.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Each of the three days has a specific, concrete note on what worked and what broke down.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Entries are specific across all three days, and the reflection identifies a genuine, actionable change based on the pattern across days.

lookFors: The three days described are consecutive and real, not compressed into a single sitting after the fact.
The 'what didn't work' notes name an actual mechanism (a missed step, a format mismatch) rather than restating that it was hard.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
